content.short: Kraken Wallet is a self-custody Web3 wallet built to connect you to the decentralized web with privacy and security.
content.description: Kraken Wallet is a multichain, self-custody Web3 wallet designed to connect you with the decentralized finance ecosystem. It welcomes both Kraken clients and non-clients alike, offering true self-custody of your digital assets and data while delivering a seamless on-chain experience. Built on strong privacy and security foundations, the wallet pairs user-owned keys with robust safeguards and reliable support, ensuring you can explore DeFi with confidence and clarity.
content.meta: Kraken Wallet is a Web3 wallet platform. Discover Kraken Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
